description: This source file defines exception classes used in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, including a base SerializerException and multiple specialized exception classes related to serialization errors, such as schema issues, type mismatches, reference problems, and unsupported operations.

classes.name: SerializerException
classes.description: Base exception class for serializer-related errors.

classes.name: FieldIdNotPresentException
classes.description: Thrown when a field ID is expected but not present.

classes.name: SchemaTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when the schema type is invalid.

classes.name: FieldTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when a field type is invalid.

classes.name: FieldTypeMissingException
classes.description: Thrown when a field type is missing during deserialization.

classes.name: ExtendedWireTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when an extended wire type is invalid.

classes.name: UnsupportedWireTypeException
classes.description: Thrown when a wire type is unsupported.

classes.name: ReferenceNotFoundException
classes.description: Indicates a reference ID was not found.

classes.name: UnknownReferencedTypeException
classes.description: Indicates that a referenced type is unknown.

classes.name: ReferenceFieldNotSupportedException
classes.description: Indicates that reference fields are not supported in this context.

classes.name: UnknownWellKnownTypeException
classes.description: Indicates an unknown well-known type identification.

classes.name: IllegalTypeException
classes.description: Indicates an illegal or disallowed type encountered.

classes.name: TypeMissingException
classes.description: Thrown when a type is missing during deserialization.

classes.name: RequiredFieldMissingException
classes.description: Indicates a required field was missing.

classes.name: CodecNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when no suitable codec is found for a type.

classes.name: UnexpectedLengthPrefixValueException
classes.description: Indicates an incorrect length prefix value.

classes.name: ExceptionHelper
classes.description: Provides utility methods for exception handling, e.g., throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: ThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: A generic method to throw an ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a given argument.
